## Summary

- **Credential-bearing probe surface** — `Transport::discover` +
  `Transport::probe_capability` take the `CredentialHandle` exactly as
  `send` does (the value resolves inside the call and drops — ADR-0366
  D4); `probe_capability` also carries the claim-shaping calls' provider
  model id.
- **`HttpModelTransport` live probe primitives** — authenticated
  `GET /models` (`cap.model_listing` + the `served_model.<id>` pin
  fold), Messages `POST /messages/count_tokens` where the dialect
  declares the member, and one cached tiny streaming call serving
  `cap.streaming` / `cap.snapshot_id_exposed` /
  `cap.cache_state_visible` via *raw-document member observation*
  (never the normalized-only view). A capability with no primitive is
  typed `UnsupportedFeature`; a probe failure is a `ModelError` — never
  a silent or fabricated row.
- **`hh_gateway::probes::exec_probe_decl`** — the open-path executor:
  bind credential → discover → served-model pin fold →
  `run_transport_probes` (declared rows + canary honesty clause) →
  idp/1 `probe_run_id` → rows for the arm to mint; measured probe usage
  rides `observed.usage` on the probed row (metered, never estimated).
- **`router` slot `probe_exec[]` + `pricing{}`** — decoded pure in
  `router_arm_from_params`; lanes execute on the open path only
  (`arm_routing_lane(…, execute_probe_execs)` — resume re-folds durable
  rows, never re-probes). `model.profile.probed` +
  `model.profile.status.changed{trigger: probe_failure}` mint durable
  *before* the first `model.call.requested`.
- **Live-signal arms under declared guard sets** —
  `learned` requires `params.evolution.scores{model_ref → score}` (the
  replayable recorded outcomes; missing ⇒ `PolicyInvalid`, unscored ⇒
  `policy_excluded`, `inputs_read` records `recorded_outcomes`);
  `health_aware` folds `model.profile.probed` verdicts + attempt rows
  through the role-table `probe_targets` join and refuses
  `PolicyInvalid` on zero observations — an unobserved candidate never
  sorts above a measured one; `cost_cap` reads the dated
  `DeclaredPricing` view (`{table_ref, source, retrieved,
  max_age_days, models}` — stale/unprovenanced ⇒ `NoPrice` per
  candidate, never zero-cost or invented).

## Live evidence (ADR-0363) — `live-executed`

- **`routing-probe` → pass — measured $0.000033:**
  `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-21-routing-probe.json` + redacted
  transcript. All three `probe_exec` lanes executed live at open —
  `openai-compatible@1` (`qwen2.5:7b-instruct`), `anthropic-messages@1`
  (`claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, incl. the `count_tokens` primitive),
  `openai@1` (`gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14`) — model listings +
  capability verdicts `SUPPORTED` against the pins; the routed run's
  `model.route.decided{policy_ref: policy.r45e@1}` selected the
  `health_aware` lane over the just-probed observations;
  `model.call.completed` with usage; credential-value leak sweep clean
  across payloads + blobs; ledger verified.
- `SPEND.jsonl` R4.5e recorded total **$15.000633** vs the USD 5
  allocation — the measured leg ($0.000033) plus **two $5
  declared-budget debits** from two development-attempt legs that
  failed before producing measured usage (the framework's conservative
  un-measured rule — recorded, not hidden). The provider consoles
  remain the spend authority (ADR-0363 D4; GATE-G6 reconciles).

## Deviation — size budget (recorded; operator ruling owed)

**≈2,320 changed lines** (≈1,080 product+arm cells in
`hh-gateway`/`hh-embed` src, ≈382 hermetic cells, ≈776 live-test leg,
≈84 live-verify script) vs the 800 budget — **≈2.9×**, recorded per the
R4.5b/R4.5d precedent: the credential-bearing probe surface, the
per-family probe primitives, three live-signal arms' signal plumbing,
the hermetic arm cells, and the three-family live leg are one atomic
feature — a per-arm split strands the probe executor from the health
fold that proves it. Sixth consecutive live-track overrun; systematic
under-pricing carried to GATE-G7. The operator's merge gate on this PR
is the decision point.

## Recorded engineering deviation (ADR-0367 D3)

The spec's "price discovery" is discharged by the dated declared
pricing view + a staleness bound — no admitted provider serves a
machine-readable price API, so no live price primitive is probed.
Whether the requirement's verdict reads MET-DIFFERENTLY is GATE-G6's
accounting per the ticket's own note — not self-ruled here.
